{{Quote|That doesn't sound good. How angry will Princess Leia be?''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''That depends on what he's smashing. If it's the singing lamp the Jumerians gave her as a wedding present, she might even thank him.|translated=1|Mallatobuck and Chewbacca upon hearing their son, Lumpawaroo, ransacking the Solos' apartment|<ref name="Forest">''[[A Forest Apart]]''</ref>}}
The '''Jumerians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Jumeria system/Legends|Jumeria system]]<ref name="FrySpecies">{{Planetnamia|species=Jumerian|system=[[Jumeria system/Legends|Jumeria system]]|legends=1}}</ref> of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Some Jumerians later became members of the [[New Republic]].<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa]] to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> a number of Jumerians presented [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] with a [[singing lamp]] as a gift for her [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|wedding]]. Although she disliked the item, she kept it in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Solos' apartment|apartment]] she shared with her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Forest" />

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[A Forest Apart]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] visited the apartment with their [[Chewbacca's family/Legends|son]] [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawaroo]], who began rummaging through the space. As the [[Parent/Legends|parents]] listened to objects breaking inside, Solo commented that while his [[Gender/Legends|wife]] might be angry about the damage depending on what items were affected, she would probably appreciate if the Jumerians' singing lamp was one of the items broken.<ref name="Forest" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jumerians were first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[eBook]] novel ''[[A Forest Apart]]'', written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Forest" />
